title.narrative: Sustainable Transformation of Domestic Agrifood Systems in Fiji, Samoa, and Solomon Islands

description.narrative: Contract related to: Sustainable Transformation of Domestic Agrifood Systems in Fiji, Samoa, and Solomon Islands - The action will assist PICs to pursue their objective to transition to a green and blue economy. It will contribute to increasing climate-resilient green food production while sustaining the natural resource base in coastal and atoll communities. It will do so by promoting agro-ecology and organic regenerative farming systems, agroforestry and circular water-agriculture systems, and by strengthening the food/water/energy nexus.
